Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The input text describes two distinct proteomics phases: a discovery phase using TMT-labeled DDA (HiRIEF) and a validation phase using unlabeled DIA. The PRIDE metadata provided (PXD024544) specifically corresponds to the DIA validation cohort. I have routed based on the PRIDE metadata's DIA/LFQ focus, while noting the phosphorylation search parameters mentioned in the discovery methods which are often carried over or relevant for PTM-aware reanalysis.

scope: Tumor cells were collected by Magnetic-activated cell sorting (MACS) using CD19 beads (Miltenyi Biotec).
Cell pellets were lysed by 4% SDS lysis buffer and prepared for mass spectrometry analysis using a modified version of the SP3 protein clean-up and digestion protocol.
Each sample was dissolved in 200 µl lysis buffer (25 mM HEPES pH 7.6, 4% SDS, 1 mM DTT), heated at 90 oC for 5 min and sonicated for 1 min.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS consisted of total protein extracts from CD19+ enriched leukemia cells. While the cells were isolated/enriched via MACS, the subsequent proteomics processing involved whole-cell lysis (SDS buffer, sonication) without further subcellular fractionation or affinity purification of specific proteins/complexes.

A factorial design was explicitly used to analyze the interaction between IGHV status and Trisomy 12.
